cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
s: Sika® Filler-101 is suitable for indoor filling work on plaster boards, fabrics, old wallpapers, etc.
Sika® Filler-101 has a very smooth finish

Sika® Filler-101 complies with EN 15824 “Specifications for external and internal plasters based on organic binders” and EN 13963 “Jointing materials for gypsum plasterboards” – Type 3A (ready-mix, dual-purpose compound)

cl.x: Clean, free from dust, dry and oil.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.

s: Consumption: Depends on the substrate roughness and thickness of the layer applied. As a guide, ~ 1 l of Sika® Filler-101 can fill ~ 1 m² per mm thick.
Layer thickness: 3 mm max.

r: Depends on the substrate roughness and thickness of the layer applied. As a guide, ~ 1 l of Sika® Filler-101 can fill ~ 1 m² per mm thick.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
cl.x: Sika® Filler-101 is supplied ready to use - no mixing is required.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
s: Sika® Filler-101 can be applied with spatula in layer thicknesses from 0 - 3 mm.

When filling deeper holes or cracks the filler must be applied in several layers and must be allowed to almost dry. Holes and cracks from 4 - 15 mm can more easily be filled with Sika® Filler-105. When dried finish the surface with Sika® Filler-101.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.

Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clauses 5.2 to 5.3 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. Where the data sheet states different limits for the same condition, apply the more restrictive limit and refer to manufacturer.
